claude_proposed_widenings.name: mode_conditional_operations
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Control Water selects one of four persistent modes at cast time, switchable via Magic action. Each mode's ongoing mechanical effects (Whirlpool's per-turn pull + damage) are only active while that mode is selected. The ongoing_effect family has a fixed operations array with no conditional-on-mode variant—there is no surface way to say 'fire this operation only while Whirlpool is the active mode.' The atoms (force_move pull, save_gate) exist; the delivery wrapper does not.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action on your later turns, you can repeat the same effect or choose a different one.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_creature_spends_action_to_escape
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Whirlpool's escape mechanic requires the trapped creature to spend its own action and succeed on an Athletics check to break free. OngoingTrigger has on_caster_spends_action but nothing for 'target creature spends its action attempting escape from an ongoing restraining/pulling effect.' This is a new trigger variant on the target's action economy.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature can swim away from the whirlpool only if it first takes an action to pull away and succeeds on a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: raise_water_level
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Flood mode raises standing water by up to 20 feet and creates a traveling wave that transports Huge-or-smaller vehicles, with a 25% capsizing chance. This is a deterministic (and random-table) environmental water-manipulation effect with no v4 atom representation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You cause the water level of all standing water in the area to rise by as much as 20 feet. If you choose an area in a large body of water, you instead create a 20-foot tall wave that travels from one side of the area to the other and then crashes. Any Huge or smaller vehicles struck by the wave have a 25% chance of capsizing.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: part_water
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Part Water mode creates a trench through the spell area and walls of water on either side, altering traversability of the terrain. No v4 atom covers water-parting or terrain-reshaping at this level.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You part water in the area and create a trench. The trench extends across the spell's area, and the separated water forms a wall to either side.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: redirect_water_flow
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Redirect Flow mode causes flowing water in the area to move in a caster-chosen direction regardless of obstacles or gravity. No v4 atom covers directed environmental flow control.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You cause flowing water in the area to move in a direction you choose, even if the water has to flow over obstacles, up walls, or in other unlikely directions.
